heroHeadline: 102 Areas Under Calamity as Benguet Declares Province-Wide Emergency, Typhoon Obet Reinforces Habagat
heroSubtitle: M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira-Obet storm sequence have killed 158+ and affected 7.5 million+, with 102 cities, municipalities and provinces — including all of Benguet — now under a state of calamity as Typhoon Obet (Saudel) briefly crossed the PAR to further enhance the southwest monsoon
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
